texts.name: booklet: Musica Gloria, Handel track list
texts.text:
GEORG FRIEDRICH HÄNDEL [1685-1759]
Chandos Anthem No. 10 The Lord is my light, HWV 255
1] Symphony 02:53
2] Air - The Lord is my light (Maria)* 02:31
3] Chorus - Though an host of men 02:24
4] Air - One thing have I desired (André) 04:02
5] Chorus - I will offer in his dwelling 02:46
6] Chorus - For who is God 01:33
7] Chorus - They are brought down 01:35
8] Chorus - O praise the Lord with me 01:06
9] Air - The Lord is my strenght (Adriaan) 02:04
10] Air - It is the Lord (Ella) 01:40
11] Chorus - Sing praises 04:17
Concerto for oboe, strings & continuo in B-flat major, HWV 302a
12] Vivace 01:59
13] Fuga 02:10
14] Andante 02:14
15] Allegro 01:50
Chandos Anthem No. 6 As pants the hart, HWV 251b
16] Symphony 03:20
17] Chorus - As pants the hart 03:25
18] Air - Tears are my daily food (Sophia) 02:31
19] Recit & Chorus - Now, when I think (Thomas) 02:41
20] Duetto - Why so full of grief (Pieter & Adriaan) 03:58
21] Chorus - Put thy trust in God (Vincent) 03:46 TT: 54:47

* This aria is originally for tenor solo, but in aiming for a balanced programme, we decided
to perform it as a soprano solo in the tradition of Händel himself, who often changed voice
types between different versions of the same piece.
